name: client-gamepad-testing
description: How gamepad and game controller work in GnollHack is tested on real devices: which device a change must be tested on, decided by whether it is shared controller code, tested on the Steam Deck as the primary device through the Avalonia Linux build, or specific to one platform, tested there; the Xbox controller on the Avalonia Windows build as a backup; the packaging and Deploy-SteamDeck.ps1 sequence, what to do when the Deck cannot be reached, what the user must test, and how to read the Deck's logs afterward. Read whenever you plan, change or review anything that alters what a controller does or shows: GHGamepad* or GHEvdev* code, GHXInput, GHWinUI, GHGameController, GHAndroid or GHiOS code, radial menus, hint strips, focus navigation on a page, controller settings, Steam Input layouts, or the Steam keyboard. Read before reporting such work as finished.
